## Rules

- Follow only verified non-null routes.
- Validate artifact version, MIME, size, and SHA256 before download.
- No account is required for public reading or verified free downloads.
- Request delivery: formspree_live_delivery_confirmed_local_not_deployed.
- Browser analytics: umami_configured_remote_control_event_observed_public_site_not_deployed.
- No payment or public write API is active in this local candidate.
- Direct agent GET requests are not observable by browser JavaScript on static GitHub Pages.
